params.name: ys
params.let: [k*m*i for i in [1,2,3]] if t == 0 else [12*c//i for i in [1,2,3]]

stem: The table shows values of $x$ and $y$ where $y$ varies either directly or inversely with $x$. Decide which, then find the missing value $a$: $\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & {=xs[0]} & {=xs[1]} & {=xs[2]} & {=xs[3]} \\ \hline y & {=ys[0]} & {=ys[1]} & {=ys[2]} & a \end{array}$
solution: Test the first columns: y/x = ${=ys[0]/xs[0]}$ and ${=ys[1]/xs[1]}$; xy = ${=xs[0]*ys[0]}$ and ${=xs[1]*ys[1]}$.
The constant quantity is {=['y/x','xy'][t]} (also true for the third column), so the variation is {=kind}.
